name: Diving Bell
source:
A woman takes a dive and attempts to control the situation she's found herself in. The only certainties of the cold depths inside a diving bell... are love and hunger.

[From [url=https://umbringg.itch.io/diving-bell]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名女子潜水并试图控制自己所处的境况。潜水钟内寒冷的深处唯一确定的是……爱和饥饿。

[来自[url=https://umbringg.itch.io/diving-bell]Itch.io[/url]]
